svg.title: Both are recovered by the section, and their parameter differences use exactly Lα−α′,∆−∆′ and F∆−∆′. The full cancellation therefore pulls back term by term with the original mark m and true length l. Nonzero LZ α,∆implies (hH ◦π) = 0, recovering the original home failure witness, while its bound retains el/ρ unchanged. The freshness derivative is taken on its smooth germ; section recovery of both plain and proxy flux limits gives its zero affine Hessian on the specified nonwrapping domain.
